_about: Public-domain J. B. Lightfoot (1828-1889, Bishop of Durham, New Testament scholar) for the Word Hoard: The Apostolic Fathers in his translation clean from CCEL; the commentary on Colossians and Philemon, the Essays on 'Supernatural Religion' and Sermons from Project Gutenberg; and the commentaries on Galatians (tenth edition, 1890, in a 1921 reprint) and Philippians (fourth edition, 1878), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Overlap: PR #11's build_commentaries.py builds verse-keyed editions of Lightfoot on Galatians, Philippians, Colossians and Philemon; this shelf's copies of those are second copies, and Adam picks which is the reading of record. Greek in the text layers (2026-10-03): Galatians 58,702 Greek characters, Philippians 55,788, Colossians (Gutenberg) 113,616.

lightfoot-colossians-philemon: St. Paul's Epistles to the Colossians and to Philemon

lightfoot-philippians-1878: Saint Paul's Epistle to the Philippians: a revised text with introduction, notes and dissertations, fourth edition (London: Macmillan, 1878)
